# org.modkitx.common/video (MK2 → MK3, generated)

<!-- @generated by scripts/convert-mk2.mjs; re-run `pnpm convert:mk2` instead of editing. -->

Mechanically converted contribution envelopes for the v1 codecs of this MK2 extension.
The manifests are complete MK3 data. A module under `src/` marked `port-pending` below
implements `probe` only and throws `x3.mk2/port-pending` from `open`; one marked `ported`
is hand-written, owned by a human, and never regenerated.

The conversion debt of every codec below — planes v2 has no home for, applied
renames, converter defaults and v1 operations left without a handler — is data in
`MK2-CONVERSION.json` beside this file.

| ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------- | ------ |
| `org.modkitx/avi`  | `extensions/common/video/codecs/avi/codec.manifest.json`  | `src/avi/codec.js`  | ported |
| `org.modkitx/mp4`  | `extensions/common/video/codecs/mp4/codec.manifest.json`  | `src/mp4/codec.js`  | ported |
| `org.modkitx/mpeg` | `extensions/common/video/codecs/mpeg/codec.manifest.json` | `src/mpeg/codec.js` | ported |
| `org.modkitx/ogv`  | `extensions/common/video/codecs/ogv/codec.manifest.json`  | `src/ogv/codec.js`  | ported |
| `org.modkitx/webm` | `extensions/common/video/codecs/webm/codec.manifest.json` | `src/webm/codec.js` | ported |
| `org.modkitx/wmv`  | `extensions/common/video/codecs/wmv/codec.manifest.json`  | `src/wmv/codec.js`  | ported |

## Signatures added at port time

The v1 manifests of these codecs carried no magic — they routed on a path glob
matching every file, which MK3 does not accept as a wildcard. Their
`match.signatures` come from the container specifications, not from MK2:

- `org.modkitx/mp4` — `66747970` @4. Source: ISO/IEC 14496-12 §4.3 (FileTypeBox: the "ftyp" box type at byte 4).
- `org.modkitx/mpeg` — `000001ba` @0, `000001b3` @0. Source: ISO/IEC 11172-1 §2.4.3.2 (pack start code 00 00 01 BA) and ISO/IEC 11172-2 §2.4.2.3 (sequence header code 00 00 01 B3).
- `org.modkitx/ogv` — `807468656f7261` @28. Source: RFC 3533 §6 (Ogg capture pattern) + Theora I §6.1 (theora identification header, first page payload at byte 28).
- `org.modkitx/webm` — `1a45dfa3` @0. Source: RFC 8794 §4.1 (EBML header element id 1A 45 DF A3) — Matroska/WebM container.
